params.body:
A test account made on the Observatory's Accounts page (#224) gets a set-password link. While `PRELAUNCH` is on, that link opened the holding page for anyone without a preview link, so the invited person never reached the form. The only way round it was a token in `PRELAUNCH_TOKENS` and a `config:cache` on the server for every tester.

With this change an account works as a pass of its own:

- `login`, `forgot-password` and `reset-password` (the form and the post) are open behind the cover;
- a signed-in account that is not blocked passes the cover;
- registering stays closed, so only accounts the team made, or someone with a preview link made, get in. A blocked account still sees the holding page.

The set-password mail for an account whose plan opens the Observatory now also says where to go: observatory.gentells.com, then "Log in with gentells.com".

That makes the whole flow happen in the browser: Accounts page, Add a test account on the Observatory plan, the person sets a password from the mail and signs in to the Observatory.

Tests: `PreLaunchTest` (3 new) and `InternalAccountsTest` (1 new). Full suite 471/472; `BuildStampTest` fails in a worktree, as on main.
params.title: Let an account through the prelaunch cover
